title: Types prop, contract version 1
description: The prop `types` every page of the panel behind the login shares (PRD 11.12, 13.4): the read of type.list as the person who signed in, from which the shell builds the Content section of the navigation and the content list shows each entry's type and title field: the address of the content list, below which the list of a type is `<content>/<owner>:<handle>`, and its result, the document of type.list.result.v1.json the query's result codec wrote at the person's classification access, or the rejection, the problem details (problem.v1.json) of a rejected read, never both, and neither for a read the pipeline could not make, which is reported to the application's exception handler and which the navigation shows as the types being unavailable. The PHP form is Cbox\Cms\Panel\Domain\Dto\TypesProp, and the generated codec TypesPropCodecV1 writes its canonical JSON: keys sorted, no whitespace.

content.description: The address of the content list across every type, such as /cms/content; the list of one type is below it, <content>/<owner>:<handle>.

rejection.description: The problem details of a rejected read, a document of problem.v1.json, or null for an answered read. Validate it with the validator of ProblemV1.

result.description: The result of type.list, a document of type.list.result.v1.json as the query's result codec wrote it, or null for a rejected read. Validate it with the validator of TypeListV1.
